# GPUWidgets/Path

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [AffineTransform.h](AffineTransform.h): A 2D affine transform, applied to a point as x' = a x + c y + tx y' = b x + d y + ty which is the naming and the order SVG's matrix(a b c d e f) uses, and CGAffineTransform and D2D1::Matrix3x2F with it - so a document's six numbers land in the six fields without anyone having to work out a convention. (declares `AffineTransform`)
- [BackdropKernels.h](BackdropKernels.h): One pixel row's cells, summed left to right in place. (declares `BackdropScanKernel`)
- [BinKernels.h](BinKernels.h): Sorting a batch's segments into the tiles that walk them, on the GPU. (declares `BinKernel`, `ClearKernel`)
- [CoverageBatch.h](CoverageBatch.h): Every path a frame rasterizes, in one set of buffers and one run of dispatches. (declares `CoverageBatch`)
- [CoverageKernel.h](CoverageKernel.h): The format a texture the coverage kernel writes into is created in: one channel where the device takes a typed store to R8Unorm, a quarter of the memory of the RGBA8 it falls back to everywhere else. (declares `coverageFormat`, `sharedKernel`, `PathIndexedKernel`, `CoverageKernel`)
- [Path.h](Path.h): A 2D vector path built from lines, Bezier curves and primitive shapes, ready to fill on the GPU. (declares `Path`)
- [PathRasterizer.h](PathRasterizer.h): How a path's interior is decided where its contours overlap: non-zero fills wherever the winding number is not zero, even-odd wherever it is odd. (declares `FillRule`, `PathRasterizer`)
- [PathStroker.h](PathStroker.h): How a stroke ends where its sub-path is open. (declares `LineCap`, `LineJoin`, `StrokeStyle`, `DashPattern`, `dashPath`, `strokeToFill`)
- [PathTessellator.h](PathTessellator.h): Triangulates a path's filled interior into a triangle list: a flat array where every three consecutive points form one triangle, ready to upload as a vertex buffer. (declares `tessellateFill`, `tessellateStroke`, `MeshVertex`, `tessellateAntialiasedFill`)
- [PrefixSum.h](PrefixSum.h): An exclusive prefix sum over a buffer of unsigned integers, on the GPU: the levels, and the buffers between them. (declares `PrefixSum`)
- [PrefixSumKernels.h](PrefixSumKernels.h): An exclusive prefix sum over a buffer of unsigned integers, on the GPU - the two kernels PrefixSum dispatches. (declares `ScanBlockKernel`, `ScanAddKernel`)
